```json
{
  "tests": [
    {
      "name": "Happy Path with Name",
      "given": "w: bytes.Buffer, name: \"Ada\"",
      "expect": "w: \"Hello, Ada!\\n\", err: nil",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "happy"
    },
    {
      "name": "Empty Name",
      "given": "w: bytes.Buffer, name: \"\"",
      "expect": "w: \"Hello, World!\\n\", err: nil",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "input:name"
    },
    {
      "name": "Whitespace Name",
      "given": "w: bytes.Buffer, name: \"  \"",
      "expect": "w: \"Hello,   !\\n\", err: nil",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "input:name"
    },
    {
      "name": "Write Error",
      "given": "w: errorWriter{}, name: \"Ada\"",
      "expect": "w: \"Hello, Ada!\\n\", err: error(io.ErrShortWrite)",
      "polarity": "negative",
      "covers": "error:1"
    }
  ]
}
```

```go
package greet

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"testing"
)

type errorWriter struct{}

func (e errorWriter) Write(p []byte) (n int, err error) {
	return 0, io.ErrShortWrite
}

func TestWriteGreeting(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		w         func() io.Writer
		name      string
		wantOut   string
		wantErr   error
		isErr     bool
	}{
		{
			name:    "Happy Path with Name",
			w:       func() io.Writer { return &bytes.Buffer{} },
			name:    "Ada",
			wantOut: "Hello, Ada!\n",
			wantErr: nil,
			isErr:   false,
		},
		{
			name:    "Empty Name",
			w:       func() io.Writer { return &bytes.Buffer{} },
			name:    "",
			wantOut: "Hello, World!\n",
			wantErr: nil,
			isErr:   false,
		},
		{
			name:    "Whitespace Name",
			w:       func() io.Writer { return &bytes.Buffer{} },
			name:    "  ",
			wantOut: "Hello,   !\n",
			wantErr: nil,
			isErr:   false,
		},
		{
			name:    "Write Error",
			w:       func() io.Writer { return errorWriter{} },
			name:    "Ada",
			wantOut: "",
			wantErr: io.ErrShortWrite,
			isErr:   true,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			buf := &bytes.Buffer{}
			var writer io.Writer = tt.w()
			// If the test case uses a custom writer like errorWriter, 
			// we need to capture its output if possible, but for errorWriter 
			// it returns 0, so we'll just check the error.
			if _, ok := writer.(errorWriter); !ok {
				buf = writer.(*bytes.Buffer)
			}

			err := WriteGreeting(writer, tt.name)

			if (err != nil) != tt.isErr {
				t.Errorf("WriteGreeting() error = %v, wantErr %v", err, tt.isErr)
				return
			}
			if tt.isErr && !errors.Is(err, tt.wantErr) {
				t.Errorf("WriteGreeting() error = %v, wantErr %v", err, tt.wantErr)
			}
			if !tt.isErr && buf.String() != tt.wantOut {
				t.Errorf("WriteGreeting() output = %q, want %q", buf.String(), tt.wantOut)
			}
		})
	}
}
```
